Package com.example.savings_app.service

Class SavingsService

java.lang.Object
com.example.savings_app.service.SavingsService
@Service public class SavingsService extends Object
Service class for managing savings operations. This includes creating, retrieving, and deleting savings records, as well as validating user inputs and relationships.

    • createSavings

      @Transactional public Savings createSavings(Savings savings)
      Creates a new savings record after validating all relevant data, including the user, amount, milestone ID, and date. This method is transactional to ensure that all operations succeed or fail together.
      Parameters:
      savings - the savings record to be created
      Returns:
      the created savings record
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any validation fails (user, amount, milestone ID, or date)
